ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Outlook Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an Outlook process.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\OUTLOOK\\\.EXE$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppVLP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mftrace\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msbuild\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scrcons\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\scriptrunner\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")))
